text: けんしょうが　すき　なのかな？

structure.jp: けんしょうが　すき

patterns.name: 〜のかな
patterns.explanation: の plus かな means 'I wonder if it is that', guessing at an explanation for what you see. After a word like すき it becomes なの. すき　なのかな = 'I wonder if they like it'.

patterns.name: 〜が好き
patterns.span: けんしょうが　すき
patterns.explanation: The thing that is liked takes が before すき. けんしょうが　すき = 'likes prize contests'.
